PSPCL Assistant Lineman (NAC) Online Form 2026 – Cancelled – Full Details

Punjab State Power Corporation Limited (PSPCL) has released the Notification for the post of Assistant Lineman (NAC). This recruitment has been issued for 3289 posts. Applications for the PSPCL Assistant Lineman (NAC) Recruitment 2026 has Started from 15 June 2026, & Candidate can apply till 06 July 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for PSPCL Assistant Lineman (NAC) Recruitment 2026 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 15 June 2026
  • Last Date : 06 July 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 10 July 2026
  • Admit Card : Before Exam
  • Result Available : Available Soon

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, BC : Rs. 1416/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 885/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.

  • Vacancy Cancelled

  • Official Website
